messages:
sam_support: FYI — customer reported their free credits didn't expire after they upgraded from Seed->Growth. Dashboard shows 30k free tokens remaining but invoice applied charge for tokens used yesterday. Org: org_34721, acct: acct_9921. Customer says credits were supposed to expire 2025-11-01.

jess-billing: Can you paste the ledger entries + promo metadata? Also which invoice number?

sam_support: Invoice #INV-2026-0098. Relevant ledger rows:
```
ledger_id | org_id | type | amount | promo_code | expires_at
ledg_778 | org_34721 | free_pool | 30000 | FREE-SEED-2025 | 1730459200
ledg_779 | org_34721 | plan_alloc | -30000 | FREE-SEED-2025 | NULL
```
Customer-facing note: "we upgraded plan mid-cycle, credits vanished then reappeared"

sandeep-eng: Looking at the migration job that runs on plan-updates (job: plan_credit_migration v2) — bug: we copy free_pool rows into plan_alloc but drop the expires_at column if plan_id != 'seed'. That means when moving Seed credits to Growth, expires_at was set to NULL. Then our expiry sweeper ignored them so they persisted.
Repro query:
```
SELECT * FROM credits WHERE org_id='org_34721' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 5;
```
I can reproduce locally by running the upgrade flow with promo FREE-SEED-2025.

maria_prodeng: What's the blast radius? How many orgs affected?

sandeep-eng: Quick tally using recent migrations: ~18 orgs migrated seed->growth in last 30 days with same promo tag. I'll run a query and backfill plan. Plan: patch migration to keep expires_at, run backfill to set expires_at from source rows, then re-run expiry sweep. Backfill command (dry-run first):
```
python tools/backfill_credits.py --filter promo=FREE-SEED-2025 --dry-run
python tools/backfill_credits.py --filter promo=FREE-SEED-2025 --apply
```

billing-bot: plan_credit_migration v2 finished 2026-03-17T15:41:02Z (job_id=job_6629) — 18 migrations; 18 rows missing expires_at.

ops-oncall: If we run backfill, do we need to pause billing-run? Risk of re-crediting invoice. Recommend run backfill then create invoice adjustments rather than pausing invoicing.

jess-billing: Agreed. Let's compute adjustment per org and do a single credit memos batch. Sam, please prepare a short apology + adjustment note for customers.

sam_support: Drafted message below, ready to send after adjustments:
"Hi — we found an internal bug during plan upgrades that removed expiry metadata for Seed promo credits, which caused those credits not to expire. We've fixed the bug, restored expiry timestamps, and issued invoice adjustments for affected months. We apologize for the confusion — happy to walk through the changes."

sandeep-eng: Patch merged to main (PR#5123). Starting backfill (non-dry-run) now. I'll post completion.

sandeep-eng: Backfill completed. 18 orgs fixed, 0 failures. Ran expiry sweep — 12 orgs had credits expire immediately after restoration and had invoice adjustments created.

jess-billing: Created credit memos for the 12 affected orgs: CM-2026-045 .. CM-2026-056. Finance notified.

sam_support: Notified customer (org_34721) with CM-2026-047 and explanation. Customer replied :thumbsup: and asked for a short summary for their finance team — attached.

maria_prodeng: Thanks team. Action items: (1) monitoring alert if migration copies NULL expires_at; (2) run a scan weekly for promo rows with NULL expiry. I'll create tickets.

ops-oncall: Added alert: billing.migration.missing_expires (sev=low).

sam_support: Closing thread — will follow up if any customers escalate.
